branchName.instructions:
Format: <type>/<short-kebab-case-description>.

Choose exactly one type:
- "content" for Content, Page Structure, or both, such as copy, images, navigation labels, metadata, shared site data, pages, or layout.
- "docs" for repository documentation and instructions only, such as README.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and similar documentation.
- "fix" for broken or incorrect behavior, layout, accessibility, performance, or functionality, including an uncovered design gap in an existing capability.
- "feature" for one cohesive new or expanded capability.

Use a concise, specific, lowercase kebab-case description. Do not use any other prefix.
